what: The `mpd` preset row still registers and a session still MOUNTS it after the two host-row id-targets were removed from cordis.patch.yml.

self_test.detail: 32 harness rows conform against the installed schemas; mpd preset 28 child rows; row parity 26/25; 4/4 negative controls reddened

live_run.negative_control: agent-preset/invalid, persona $.prefix missing required value (4/4 arms reddened)
live_run.only_failure: bootLog {"ok":false,"signatures":["did not activate"]} — caused SOLELY by the new mpd-tui-adapter row whose dist does not exist yet: boot.log line 17 `dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate` + line 18 `mpd-tui-adapter (@mpd-dsh/mpd/packages/mpd-tui-adapter-plugin/dist/index.js): failed to import`
live_run.measured_consequence: An unresolvable module path is NOT boot-fatal on harness 0.2.0-rc.2: the row degrades to a warning + non-activating entry, and the session still mounts `mpd`. The lane still counts it as a failure, so the dist must land in the same tree.
live_run.note: The first run (before Lane A dist) is kept as the measurement of the non-activating row.

isolation: isolated DSH_HOME + HOME + sandboxed workspace cwd (the lane asserts no session store key outside the sandbox); the real ~/.dsh was never read or written except the one-time credential/settings copy the lane performs by design

live_run_after_lane_a_dist.result: [preset-conformance] PASS — bootLog {"ok":true,"signatures":[]}, sessionCreate/sessionHeader agentPreset mpd, negative control agent-preset/invalid
